integrity: An exact symbolic proof is provided; the standard-library rational program is a reproducibility check, not an infinite proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Synchronous all-active schedule, zero prejudices, homogeneous positive coefficients and equal community sizes. The sharp threshold is for the specified alternating block-constant two-cycle, not for every orbit or asynchronous activation. Broad historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Sharp two-community oscillation threshold in a coevolving public-goods opinion network
